title: Example Mini Exam — 3 questions, 5 minutes
description: A short example showing the exam file format. Copy it, change the questions, and put it in your exam folder.

questions.text: Which `stop_reason` value means the agentic loop should **continue**?
questions.why: `tool_use` means the model asked for a tool: run it, append the `tool_result`, and call the model again.

questions.text: Which two built-in tools search the codebase? (select exactly 2)
questions.why: Grep searches contents and Glob matches paths. Write and Edit change files.

questions.text: `select` defaults to 1 when left out. Which option is correct?
